question: Six months on, 22% of smokers told to quit abruptly and 15.5% told to taper were abstinent. How many smokers per extra success?
move: Turn two rates into extra successes per hundred before judging a difference.
ask: Next time I read a percentage gap in a health claim, will I convert it to people per hundred?
trap: Comparing the two rates as a ratio instead of a difference.
hint: Work out how many extra quitters per 100 smokers the abrupt route gives.
source: Lindson-Hawley et al., Annals of Internal Medicine, 2016
reference: Lindson-Hawley, Banting, West, Michie, Shinkins & Aveyard, Gradual versus abrupt smoking cessation: a randomized, controlled noninferiority trial, Annals of Internal Medicine, 2016
